lines.lyric_translation: Can’t see the end, the questions continue

lines.lyric: Naega naege mutgo dasi doemureo ireon ildeul
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 내게 묻고 다시 되물어 이런 일들
lines.lyric_translation: I ask myself again and again
If I can endure through these things

lines.lyric: Geureom amureohji anheun deut wae mot beotinyago
lines.lyric_hangul: 그럼 아무렇지 않은 듯 왜 못 버티냐고
lines.lyric_translation: Then as if it’s nothing, I say, why can’t I?

lines.lyric: Sasil ani jogeum manhi himi deureo
lines.lyric_hangul: 사실 아니 조금 많이 힘이 들어
lines.lyric_translation: Actually, it’s been really hard
The fact that there’s not a single person
Who will listen to my secrets that

lines.lyric: Saram hana eopdaneun geu sasiri nal ulkeok
lines.lyric_hangul: 사람 하나 없다는 그 사실이 날 울컥
lines.lyric_translation: I’ve been keeping makes me sad

lines.lyric: Hage mandeureobeorineun i hyeonsiri nal ullyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 하게 만들어버리는 이 현실이 날 울려
lines.lyric_translation: This reality makes me cry
Can’t see the end
When I open my eyes in bed

lines.lyric: Ajik mujungryeok han kkume heeonaji mothan chae
lines.lyric_hangul: 아직 무중력 한 꿈에 헤어나지 못한 채
lines.lyric_translation: I still haven’t come out of my gravity defying dream
Is it morning? Is it night? I don’t even know

lines.lyric: Mongrongham henggwo naeryeo haedo wae geudaeronde
lines.lyric_hangul: 몽롱함 헹궈 내려 해도 왜 그대론데
lines.lyric_translation: As I wash away the haziness at the sink
But everything stays the same
I see myself in the mirror with

lines.lyric: Sangdanghi sanghan pibuwa mokjeogeul ilheun deuthan
lines.lyric_translation: several days worth of makeup
My skin is ruined and I feel like I lost my goal
The dark circles underneath just get deeper
Feels like I’m floating in space
I don’t know where to go

lines.lyric: Jeo meolli byeori nal ikkeureo yeah
lines.lyric_hangul: 저 멀리 별이 날 이끌어 yeah
lines.lyric_translation: But the stars far away pull me

lines.lyric: I can feel it, I can feel it
lines.lyric_hangul: i can feel it i can feel it
lines.lyric_translation: I Can Feel It, I Can Feel It

lines.lyric: Naega bichi doel su isseumeul neukkyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 빛이 될 수 있음을 느껴
lines.lyric_translation: I feel like I can be a light
Can’t see the end
I ran all the way from the start without rest, but why

lines.lyric: Wonrae nae moseubeun da eodi gago
lines.lyric_hangul: 원래 내 모습은 다 어디 가고
lines.lyric_translation: Where did my usual self go?
What am I chasing after every day?
I pray every day that it
won’t be a lie
when I say I’m ok
But why are the expectations so high?
I wipe away the bursting tears
I think of my family and dream once again

lines.lyric_hangul: 끝이 안보여 날 좀 내버려 둬
lines.lyric_translation: Can’t see the end, / leave me alone
Actually, I’m miserable,
after I finish a packed schedule
Expectations from friends and family
follow me into bed

lines.lyric: Maneurodo du nun tteun chae jam mot deureo
lines.lyric_hangul: 만으로도 두 눈 뜬 채 잠 못 들어
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t even close my eyes and sleep
I forgot how to go for it all
Now I have a habit of avoiding the little things
Can’t see the end, typical words “have strength”
It’s not the same as before,
why am I so desperate?
Feels like I’m floating in space
I don’t know where to go

lines.lyric_translation: I feel like I can be a light

lines.lyric: Jeo meolli kkeute naega wonhadeon ge isseuljido molla
lines.lyric_hangul: 저 멀리 끝에 내가 원하던 게 있을지도 몰라
lines.lyric_translation: Maybe what I want is over there at the end
Getting what I want will be harder than just
determination
But I can’t be impatient
anymore

lines.lyric: Dasi gireul ilhneundamyeon nareul chajeumyeon dwae
lines.lyric_hangul: 다시 길을 잃는다면 나를 찾으면 돼
lines.lyric_translation: If I’m lost again, I need to find it again
Feels like I’m floating in space
I don’t know where to go
